subject: Collaborative close plan + MAP template (prototype & co-edit invite)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Emily Turner <emily@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Collaborative close plan + MAP template (prototype & co-edit invite)

Emily —

Great speaking yesterday — thanks for the candid notes on expandability and audit controls. As promised, I attached a lightweight MAP prototype to kick off co-authoring. The goal: capture the technical validation milestones, security checklist owners, and a pragmatic 6-week close runway so your team and ours have a single source of truth.

Quick summary of what I included in the doc:
- Week 0: kickoff + environment access (owner: Brightline infra)
- Week 1–2: core validation (latency, hallucination checks, data privacy spot tests)
- Week 3–4: integration & acceptance criteria (API keys, inference throughput targets)
- Week 5–6: final sign-off + procurement steps (SLA review, PO/contract)

Ask: can your security lead drop initial answers in the "Security gating" tab by EOD Fri so we can size the Dedicated capacity recommendation? I’ll set up a 45-minute co-edit session where we walk through the doc with your engineering and procurement folks.

Attachments: MAP_prototype_v0.9.gdoc (Google Doc stub) — link below.

GDrive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP_prototype_v0.9
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2026-0231

Thanks — I’ll be offline Wed afternoon but available Thurs/Fri mornings.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Emily Turner <emily@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 12:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Collaborative close plan + MAP template (prototype & co-edit invite)

Thanks Stephanie — this looks like exactly what we need. Appreciate the level of detail on the gating items. A few quick notes: 

- Security: I’ll loop in Ravi (our SecOps) — he prefers to answer questionnaires in a doc we can both edit.
- Timeline: the 6-week runway is doable if the integration tasks stay scoped. Can we tighten Week 1 deliverables to a 3-day run to validate inference quality?
- Procurement: our procurement lead will need an initial SOW stub for internal approvals — can Redwood provide a short SOW by Week 2?

I’m available for the co-edit on Thursday morning ET. Send a calendar invite and we’ll confirm attendees.

Best,
Emily Turner
Director of Engineering, Brightline Health
emily@brightlinehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Collaborative close plan + MAP template (prototype & co-edit invite)

Looping in a few tactical suggestions from an ops perspective — I reviewed the MAP and the attached slides. Quick edits I recommend before the co-edit: 

1) Acceptance criteria: add a short, measurable checklist for hallucination tolerance (examples + test prompts).
2) Data residency: clarify whether Brightline wants token-level retention disabled for trial datasets (two options listed).
3) Cost estimate: add a short table with baseline token consumption assumptions for the Week 3 integration tests so procurement sees a conservative monthly run rate.
4) Owners: mark internal owners for infra, security evidence, and CS check-ins (helps with weekly sync agendas).

I’ll add these as comments in the GDoc and drop a short slide in the slides stub so Emily can share with procurement. I’m available Thursday for the co-edit — suggest 9:00 PT (12:00 ET).

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Emily Turner <emily@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collaborative close plan + MAP template (prototype & co-edit invite)

Emily — thanks for the quick read and the timeline callout. I incorporated Marissa’s suggestions and seeded examples for the hallucination checks and a conservative token-cost table. I also added a short SOW stub in the appendix per your procurement ask.

Here are the next steps I propose: 
- Co-edit session: Thu 9:00 PT / 12:00 ET — I just sent the calendar invite.
- Action item before co-edit: Ravi (SecOps) to add initial answers in the "Security gating" tab by Wed EOD — that will let us finalize the isolation recommendations.
- Deliverables during Week 2: initial SOW stub + procurement checklist (owner: Redwood procurement)

Live co-edit doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP_prototype_v0.9
Slides stub (for procurement): MAP_playbook_slide_stub_v1.gslides

If the co-edit goes well we’ll freeze the MAP by Week 3 and use it as the single source of truth for weekly syncs. Sound good?

Best,
—Stephanie
